ModMetaData.name: Spine
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
The shared library the rest of my mods are built on. It does nothing by itself - install it because another mod asks for it.
- Consistent settings pages with search and a Simple/Advanced split - Alt-click a mod's own controls to jump straight to the setting behind them - Stable tooltips and bounded caching - Guarded Harmony patch installation, attributed to the mod that asked for it
Requires Harmony. Load Spine before anything that depends on it.
